etymology.historical_story: McKenna is an anglicized form of Gaelic Mac Cionaodha, meaning 'son of Cionaodh'. Woulfe's historical surname dictionary associates one family with Trough in northern County Monaghan. This is a history of a family name, rather than a Malay derivation: its appearance in Malay writing does not turn Mc- into a productive Malay prefix. Source: [Woulfe's surname entry](https://libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/macc/mac-cionaodha-mac-cionaoith.php).
